name: Yule Cat
body:
YULE CAT
CR 12

This enormous cat seemingly composed entirely of mist prepares its haunches for a prodigious leap.

XP 19,200
N Huge magical beast
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, see in darkness; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 13, flat-footed 22 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +14 natural, ?2 size)
hp 168 (16d10+80); fast healing 10
Fort +15, Ref +14, Will +11
Defensive Abilities limited immortality, quick recovery; DR 10/cold iron; Immune cold; SR 23

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +21 (3d6+7/19–20), 2 claws +21 (2d8+7)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks pounce, sneak attack +4d6
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th; concentration +19)

Constant—blur
At will—deeper darkness
3/day—shadow walk (DC 19)
1/day—plane shift (DC 20)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 19, Con 20, Int 15, Wis 22, Cha 17
Base Atk +16; CMB +25; CMD 40 (44 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Death from Above, Dodge, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Mobility, Skill Focus (Intimidate), Spring Attack
Skills Acrobatics +18, Climb +20, Intimidate +20, Perception +21, Stealth +14, Survival +19
Languages Giant, Sylvan
SQ planar acclimation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Limited Immortality (Su)

Though the Yule Cat still needs to eat, drink, and sleep, it doesn’t age and can’t die of old age.

If the Yule Cat is killed, a new one forms elsewhere in the world after a year’s time—this new Yule Cat retains the memories of the previous one and likely holds a grudge against the person who killed it the year before. If a method to disrupt this cycle exists, it has yet to be discovered by mortals.

Planar Acclimation (Ex)

The Yule Cat is always considered to be on its home plane, regardless of what plane it finds itself upon. It never gains the extraplanar subtype.

Quick Recovery (Su)

If the Yule Cat is debilitated, it recovers with frightening speed. If it starts its turn affected by any or all of the following conditions, these conditions end at the end of its turn: confused, dazed, dazzled, exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, sickened, and stunned. Furthermore, if the Yule Cat is affected by ability damage, ability drain, or a mind-affecting effect that allows a save, it receives a single additional save against the effect of its choice at the original DC at the end of its turn in order to shake off the effect.

ECOLOGY

Environment any cold or temperate
Organization solitary
Treasure none

The origins of the Yule Cat, named Jólakötturinn or sometimes simply Jóla for short, are shrouded in mystery.

By all accounts the massive cat-like creature simply appeared one snow-shrouded winter night and left a bloody trail in its wake as it hunted and toyed with any living creature in its path. Over the years some sparse lore has emerged about the legendary monster – it prefers the cold and dark, particularly in a wild or untamed setting, but is by no means limited to such settings, it emerges to hunt only during the winter months, like many fey creatures the Jólakötturinn is bound by rules that are only known and make sense to it, and it is an enemy of stagnation and entropy as it refuses to hunt those clothed in new garments, adornments that are simply new to them or otherwise marked by change and rebirth.

Shrouded in constantly shifting shadows, the monster is clearly feline in general shape but seems to have a shifting number of eyes, limbs, and even tails. Accounts differ beyond those details, and virtually no documented evidence of the Jólakötturinn exist, as the beast makes a point of destroying anything recording its presence.

Outside of conspiracy theorists, few people believe the Jólakötturinn exists.

Like other creatures of the Tane, the Yule Cat is a creature of the primal world of the fey. When not on the hunt in the Material Plane, the Jólakötturinn spends time with Grýla. The Yule Cat, like many other cats, decides whether or not to heed Grýla’s commands but is protective of her when others attack.

Yule Tane

The Yule Tane are a group of otherworldly beings from the Fey Realms. They touch the world from time to time, most often in the darkest and coldest times of the year. They are attuned to festivals and celebrations, with a keen sense for being mischief, menace, and even murder if their mysterious appetites are not appeased and their strict adherence to traditions and observances are not followed.
